title: When Are We Near Nash? Certifying Solutions in General-Sum Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.29300v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Heuristic solvers for general-sum extensive-form games produce a stream of iterates, and practice reports the NashGap of the returned profile. We ask what a solver can know about its own iterates from the regret accumulators and the terminal-distribution accumulators its updates already maintain. In two-player games the NashGap of a weighted average strategy equals, at the maximizing player, the weighted external regret plus a signed value correction. Bounding the regret by the running counterfactual-regret accumulator gives an online certificate whose cost per checkpoint is linear in the number of terminal histories. The certificate stays sound under alternating updates and in games with three or more players. The mismatch between what alternation evaluates and what the averages record enters as one signed comparator term, maximized in a single backward pass per player whose comparator weight is nonzero. translated_title: 我们何时接近纳什？通用和博弈中解的认证
translated_abstract: 通用和扩展式博弈的启发式求解器会产生一系列迭代解，实践中通常报告所返回策略组合的纳什间隙。我们探讨的问题是：求解器能够从其更新过程已经维护的遗憾累积器和终止分布累积器中，了解到关于自身迭代解的哪些信息。在双人博弈中，加权平均策略的纳什间隙在最大化玩家处等于加权外部遗憾加上一个带符号的值修正项。通过运行中的反事实遗憾累积器对遗憾进行界定，可以得到一种在线证书，其在每个检查点的计算成本与终止历史的数量呈线性关系。该证书在交替更新的情况下以及三人或更多玩家的博弈中依然保持可靠。交替更新所评估的内容与平均值所记录的内容之间的不匹配，表现为一个带符号的比较项；对于比较权重非零的每个玩家，该项可在每次单次反向扫描中被最大化。该界限可从遗憾累积器中直接读取……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在线认证方法，利用求解器自身已维护的遗憾累积器和终止分布累积器来界定通用和扩展式博弈中近似纳什均衡的质量，且每个检查点的成本与终止历史数量呈线性关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an online certificate that uses the regret and terminal-distribution accumulators already maintained by solvers to bound the quality of approximate Nash equilibria in general-sum extensive-form games, with per-checkpoint cost linear in the number of terminal histories.
